title: AWS Lambda consumer for self-managed Apache Kafka with OAuth through Amazon Cognito (Java)
description: The function consumes from a self-managed Apache Kafka cluster on Amazon EC2 that authenticates clients with SASL/OAUTHBEARER. Amazon Cognito stands in for any OAuth 2.0 identity provider: the event source mapping obtains access tokens with the client credentials grant (OAUTHBEARER_AUTH), and the brokers validate them against the user pool's JSON Web Key Set.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Self-managed Apache Kafka with SASL/OAUTHBEARER through an external OAuth 2.0 provider (Amazon Cognito): the event source mapping obtains access tokens with the client credentials grant (OAUTHBEARER_AUTH).

The AWS CloudFormation template KafkaBrokersCognitoClientEC2.yaml creates the Kafka cluster and an Amazon EC2 client instance; the AWS Lambda function and its event source are deployed with AWS SAM or the AWS CLI.
The function decodes each Kafka record, logs it to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, and writes its fields to Amazon DynamoDB.
For detailed deployment instructions, see the README.md.
